# Generated Dependencies

This folder is populated automatically by `build_windows.py` on Windows.

Expected generated paths include `lhm/`, `pawnio/`, `_nuget/` and `_tools/`. These downloaded DLLs, drivers, installers and package caches are not stored in the GitHub source release. The build process acquires them from their upstream sources; see [the build guide](../docs/BUILDING.md).
